map.为什么均值和中位数都要看？: Why Look at Both the Mean and the Median?
map.均值受极端值影响大，中位数不易被极端值带偏。两者接近说明数据分布均匀；均值明显低: The mean is strongly affected by extreme values while the median is not easily skewed by them. If the two are close the data is evenly distributed; if the mean is clearly below the median there is an unusually low month, and the specific cause must be located.
map.季度复盘时把每天的新增/流失/留存数粘贴进来，一次性算出总量与离散程度，作为运营: At the quarterly review, paste in the daily new / churned / retained counts to compute the totals and the dispersion at once, as a basis for checking operating KPIs.
map.对比不同门店或不同课程的会员留存数据，用中位数与标准差识别异常店与波动大的课程。: Compare member retention data across stores or courses, using the median and standard deviation to identify outlier stores and highly variable courses.
map.方差/标准差用总体还是样本口径？: Should the Variance and Standard Deviation Use the Population or the Sample Basis?
map.本工具用总体口径（除以 n），因为粘贴进来的这组数据就是你要分析的全部指标。样本: This tool uses the population basis (dividing by n), because the data you pasted in is exactly the full set of indicators you want to analyze. The sample basis (dividing by n−1) is slightly larger and is used to infer the population from a sample; when the two values are close the conclusion is the same.
map.汇总月度留存率、出勤率等一串指标，快速得出均值/中位数/极差，判断整体水平与波动: Aggregate a string of indicators such as monthly retention and attendance rates to quickly get the mean, median, and range, and judge the overall level and fluctuation.
: Enter "72,75,68,80" (unit %).
Count n=4; sum 295.00; mean 73.75; median (72+75)/2=73.50; minimum 68; maximum 80; range 12.00; variance 19.19; standard deviation 4.38.
How to read it: the mean 73.75% is close to the median 73.50%, showing that the four-month retention level is stable; a standard deviation of 4.38 percentage points is normal fluctuation, so there is no need to overreact to a single month of decline.
If one month drops to 68 while the other three stay in 72–80, the range widens and the mean falls, so you should first investigate course or coach changes that month.
